# Balanced 3x2 factorial ANOVA: testing 2-level factor main effect
# Partial eta-squared = 0.06, alpha = 0.05, target power = 0.80

# Design parameters
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
partial_eta_sq <- 0.06
numerator_df <- 1  # 2-level factor has 1 DF
factor_a_levels <- 3
factor_b_levels <- 2
total_cells <- factor_a_levels * factor_b_levels

# Convert partial eta-squared to f-squared (effect size)
# Partial eta-squared = f² / (1 + f²)
# Solving for f²: f² = partial_eta_sq / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
f_squared <- partial_eta_sq / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
f <- sqrt(f_squared)

cat("=== Conversion from Partial η² to Effect Size f ===\n")
cat("Partial η²:", partial_eta_sq, "\n")
cat("f²:", f_squared, "\n")
cat("f:", f, "\n\n")

# For a balanced factorial ANOVA with n participants per cell:
# Total N = 6n
# Denominator DF = 6n - 6 (error df in the full model)
# Numerator DF = 1 (main effect of 2-level factor)
# Non-centrality parameter: λ = f × sqrt(n × numerator_df)
#   or equivalently: λ² / (numerator_df) is the expected F ratio × numerator_df

# Using pwr package for F-test power
library(pwr)

# pwr.f2.test uses f² (effect size squared) and u (numerator df), v (denominator df)
# But we need to be careful: pwr package uses Cohen's f, not f²

# Let's use the direct approach with non-centrality parameter
# Non-centrality parameter λ = f × sqrt(numerator_df × n)
# Where n is per-cell sample size

# We'll search for minimum n that achieves target power
candidate_ns <- seq(1, 200, by = 1)
achieved_powers <- numeric(length(candidate_ns))

for (i in seq_along(candidate_ns)) {
  n_per_cell <- candidate_ns[i]
  # Non-centrality parameter
  lambda <- f * sqrt(numerator_df * n_per_cell)
  # Denominator DF
  denominator_df <- total_cells * n_per_cell - total_cells
  # Power calculation using non-central F distribution
  critical_f <- qf(1 - alpha, numerator_df, denominator_df)
  achieved_powers[i] <- 1 - pf(critical_f, numerator_df, denominator_df, ncp = lambda)
}

# Find minimum n with power >= 0.80
valid_idx <- which(achieved_powers >= target_power)
if (length(valid_idx) > 0) {
  min_idx <- min(valid_idx)
  n_min <- candidate_ns[min_idx]
  power_at_min <- achieved_powers[min_idx]
  
  # Also show the preceding n

    n_preceding <- candidate_ns[min_idx - 1]
    power_at_preceding <- achieved_powers[min_idx - 1]
  } else {
    n_preceding <- NA
    power_at_preceding <- NA
  }
} else {

  n_min <- NA
  power_at_min <- NA
  n_preceding <- NA
  power_at_preceding <- NA
}

cat("Factor A levels:", factor_a_levels, "\n")
cat("Factor B levels:", factor_b_levels, "\n")
cat("Total cells:", total_cells, "\n\n")

cat("  Denominator DF:", total_cells * n_min - total_cells, "\n")
